label: Company Logo
description: A single company logo fetched from logo.dev by domain. A layout-neutral building block: drop several into a flex row for a 'trusted by' strip, or a grid (with a heading) for an 'integrates with' section. Set prominent:true for a single, full-frame, dramatically-revealed hero logo. Exposes the full logo.dev API: theme (dark/light/auto), greyscale, format, size, retina, and fallback (monogram avoids broken images for unknown domains).

prominent.label: Hero treatment (single full-frame logo with dramatic reveal)
